statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia as the potential embolic source
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to capture intermittent events over an extended period
The monitoring was ordered to identify paroxysmal arrhythmias missed during standard office evaluations
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and G45.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
